column1: # TUR's mirror of every upstream repository from which CI pulls an image by
# digest. pins.py finds the pins (image/README.md, "The base image and its
# mirror"); every pin's repository must have a line here, or pins.py check
# fails. base-mirror.yml copies each pinned digest, unchanged, to the
# repository on the right; use-base-mirror makes podman and skopeo try it
# first for a pull by digest, and gives docker the mirror's reference.
# One package per upstream image. Two upstream names of the same image (the
# Fedora container is published to quay.io and to registry.fedoraproject.org
# with the same digests) share one package.
